description: Open source-level workstreams and independent installed security gates. No row is certified solely by source tests.

items.title: Malicious dependency filesystem and network isolation
items.acceptance: Prove simulated malicious startup/postinstall code cannot read owner secrets or cloud metadata on disposable installed worker

items.title: Untrusted Git tool isolation
items.acceptance: Prove hostile hooks/filters/config do not escape the restricted executor or acquire host credentials

items.title: No Knight self-approval
items.acceptance: Prove actual effect-producing APIs reject Knight-originated forged roles, grants, scope and approvals

items.title: Signed RPC replay resistance
items.acceptance: Prove duplicate, stale epoch, wrong audience and replay messages fail across controller and worker restarts

items.title: Revocation persistence
items.acceptance: Prove a revoked worker cannot reconnect or re-enroll across restart, snapshot restore and peer sync

items.title: Network destination policy
items.acceptance: Prove loopback/private/link-local/metadata/IPv6/redirect/rebinding destinations are rejected by OS and tool policy

items.title: Independent monitor and audit integrity
items.acceptance: Prove worker cannot alter logs, trust root or audit state; verify fail closed on monitor or disk failure

items.title: Rollback cannot restore old authority
items.acceptance: Prove interrupted updates and rollback cannot resurrect revoked keys, approvals or stale leases

items.title: Authenticated durable task-to-Knight execution receipts
items.acceptance: On actual installer complete governed task including real tool effect, verified receipt and persistent audit across reboot

items.title: Always-on restart, model selection and cross-Knight recovery
items.acceptance: Installed supervisor survives reboot, replays durable queue correctly, selects available model, and safely hands failed task to independently authorized Knight

items.title: Noninterfering private native desktop worker
items.acceptance: Actual bounded native GUI tool operates in independent isolated session with no host input theft and per-effect authorization

items.title: Bounded browser automation with OS isolation
items.acceptance: Real installed browser task respects owner authorization and OS-enforced egress/folder/process isolation including hostile-page cases

items.title: SQLite contention and revocation race independent reproduction
items.acceptance: On native Windows and Linux, reproduce earlier timeout and show durable revocation under concurrent read/write and reconnect; offline restore remains valid

items.title: Clean-machine install, release and upgrade/rollback
items.acceptance: Download published matching installers and prove first launch, updated version, preserved data/authority, rollback and exit cleanup on supported OS

items.title: Exact published one-click links and truthful marketing
items.acceptance: Every beginner download resolves to published matching installer asset and hash; video labeled illustrated and version differences disclosed

items.title: Fifteen real user journeys and resource benchmarks
items.acceptance: Run measured beginner/advanced journeys, cold start, RAM, CPU, I/O and user recovery on representative supported machines

items.title: Three-node Windows native socket timeout diagnosis
items.acceptance: Repeat genuine network-process test and attribute timeout to demonstrated cause, then prove deterministic recovery

items.title: Desktop launch diagnostics and fast truthful readiness
items.acceptance: On exact native artifact show readiness only after 200 response and reduced polling overhead without shortening total deadline

items.title: Small native Android and iOS companion release
items.acceptance: Provide signed or properly installable real phone packages only after platform compliance, permission and isolated connection tests; explicitly mark unpublished until then

items.title: Release candidate v1.2.8 end-to-end certification
items.acceptance: Exact-head platform CI, staged artifacts, immutable tags and signed-heartbeat revocation regression validated before publication
